description: Get FDA US Prescribing Information (USPI) for a drug from openFDA (cited to DailyMed). Returns structured labelling sections with LOINC codes, verbatim. Long sections are paged: a cut section has truncated: true, total_chars and next_offset — call again with that section and offset to read on. Check drug_name: the best openFDA match may be a different product from the one you meant.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters returned per section (default 6000). Long sections are returned a page at a time: a cut page has truncated: true, total_chars and next_offset.

offset.description: Character offset to start each section from (default 0). To read the rest of a truncated section, call again with sections set to that one section and offset set to its next_offset.

sections.description: Specific sections to retrieve (e.g., ['indications', 'adverse reactions', 'contraindications']). Returns all sections if omitted.

name: get_uspi
